title: Sexual harassment and assault
meaning: Unwelcome sexual comments, touching, images or pressure, or any sexual act without consent. It is never the student's fault.
examples_and_warning_signs: Unwanted sexual comments, touching or messages
Pressure to send or share private images
Someone threatening to share private images
Sudden fear, withdrawal or avoiding a person or place
steps: Go to a safe place and tell an adult you trust, today.
Remember: it is not your fault.
A doctor can check and help you. If possible avoid washing before seeing one, but your safety comes first.
Do not send or share any intimate images.
Childline 1098 can explain your options and what happens next.
seek_immediate_help: You were touched or forced against your will
You are in danger now: call 112
school_support: School safeguarding or child protection officer
disclaimer: Serious cases may legally need to be reported by adults or schools. A trusted adult or Childline 1098 can explain what that means. Never share intimate images.
